symptom: Collapsing or expanding the sidebar on the dashboard feels janky. The profiler shows every stat card, chart card and the user menu re-rendering, even though none of their data changed.

truth.cause: PreferencesProvider builds its context value object and the setTheme/setLocale callbacks inline on every render. It sits inside AppShell, so AppShell's sidebar state change re-renders the provider, and every usePreferences consumer, including the memoised StatCard, re-renders on the new context identity.

referenceFix.find: import { createContext, type ReactNode, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
referenceFix.replace: import { createContext, type ReactNode, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
